name: The Glass Garden Hall
description: The Glass Garden Hall is a bright, modern indoor venue with tall windows, greenery-inspired interiors, and a clean elegant atmosphere. It works well for weddings, debuts, corporate celebrations, formal dinners, and milestone events that need a polished but welcoming setting. The venue is best for clients who want a premium, organized, and photo-friendly space without needing a full luxury hotel ballroom.

name: Casa Almeria Tagaytay
description: Casa Almeria Tagaytay is a hillside garden venue overlooking Taal, with a Mediterranean-inspired pavilion and manicured lawns. It is well-suited for couples who want a destination feel without flying out of Luzon, and it handles intimate to mid-sized weddings, anniversaries, and milestone celebrations. The property is best for clients prioritizing scenery, natural light, and a relaxed but elevated atmosphere.

name: The Workshop Loft Makati
description: The Workshop Loft Makati is a raw, industrial-style event space with exposed brick, polished concrete floors, and warm pendant lighting. It is a strong fit for product launches, brand activations, intimate weddings, creative meetups, and milestone birthdays that lean modern or minimalist. The venue is best for clients who want a cool, urban backdrop without the formality or cost of a hotel function room.

name: Hacienda San Rafael
description: Hacienda San Rafael is a heritage-style country estate in Bulacan with wide open grounds, a covered reception hall, and a relaxed provincial atmosphere. It handles large gatherings comfortably and is well-suited for traditional Filipino weddings, family reunions, and big debuts. The estate is best for clients who want generous space, a rustic-elegant backdrop, and a venue that can comfortably host extended families.

name: Sky Deck 33
description: Sky Deck 33 is a luxury rooftop venue in BGC with floor-to-ceiling glass, panoramic city views, and a sleek lounge interior. It is designed for high-end weddings, corporate galas, milestone birthdays, and brand events that want a striking, photo-forward backdrop. The venue is best for clients with a generous budget who want guests to walk in and feel impressed before the program even starts.

name: The Backyard Antipolo
description: The Backyard Antipolo is a casual outdoor garden space with string lights, plant-filled corners, and a relaxed homey feel. It is a great fit for intimate weddings, small birthdays, baby showers, bridal showers, and laid-back gatherings that prioritize warmth over formality. The venue is best for clients on a tighter budget who still want a charming, photo-friendly outdoor setting close to the metro.

name: Tita Lourdes Kitchen
services: free menu tasting for confirmed bookings
description: Tita Lourdes Kitchen is a family-run catering service known for hearty, home-style Filipino dishes served buffet-style. The team is well-loved for birthdays, family reunions, christenings, and casual milestone celebrations where comfort food is the priority. They are best for clients who want generous portions, familiar Pinoy flavors, and a warm, no-fuss service experience at a reasonable price.

name: Verde Plant-Based Catering
description: Verde Plant-Based Catering specializes in fully vegetarian and vegan menus with a modern, ingredient-forward approach. Their dishes lean Mediterranean and Asian-fusion, and the team is experienced with dietary restrictions including gluten-free, nut-free, and soy-free requests. They are best for clients hosting health-conscious crowds, plant-based weddings, or events where dietary inclusivity is a priority without sacrificing presentation.

name: Maison Blanc Fine Dining
description: Maison Blanc is a high-end catering team specializing in plated fine dining with international and modern Filipino menus. Their service is polished and ceremonial, with trained brigades and curated wine pairings, making them a strong fit for luxury weddings, corporate galas, and milestone events. They are best for clients who want a restaurant-grade dining experience and are willing to invest for the level of detail.

name: Smoke and Fire Mobile Grill
description: Smoke and Fire Mobile Grill brings a live barbecue and smokehouse experience to events, with on-site grilling, smoked brisket, ribs, chicken, and Filipino-style sides. The casual format works well for outdoor parties, casual weddings, corporate team builds, and birthdays where guests enjoy interactive food stations. They are best for clients who want a fun, smoky, crowd-pleasing menu that doubles as an experience.

name: Pulse Productions
description: Pulse Productions is a full-service lights and sounds team with experience scaling from intimate receptions to concert-style productions. Their setups are reliable for weddings, debuts, corporate conferences, and brand activations, and they bring their own technical crew on-site. They are best for clients who want professional-grade audio and dynamic lighting without coordinating multiple vendors.

name: Glow Studio Manila
description: Glow Studio Manila focuses on mood and ambient lighting, specializing in warm, romantic atmospheres rather than concert-style production. They are a great fit for intimate weddings, garden parties, anniversaries, and dinners where the lighting is meant to set a feeling rather than dominate the room. They are best for clients who want soft, photo-friendly lighting and a clean, understated audio setup.

name: Bright Box Events
description: Bright Box Events is a budget-friendly lights and sounds provider focused on birthdays, christenings, school events, and casual celebrations. Their packages cover the essentials without the bells and whistles, and they are reliable for events that need clean audio and simple lighting at an accessible price. They are best for clients on a tight budget who still want a properly run program.

name: Aurora Lighting Design
description: Aurora Lighting Design is a high-end production team known for custom lighting concepts, architectural uplighting, and gobo monogram projections. Their work elevates luxury weddings, corporate galas, and brand events with cinematic atmosphere and detailed programming. They are best for clients investing in a fully designed visual experience and willing to plan lighting as a creative element, not just utility.

name: Joaquin Cruz Photography
description: Joaquin Cruz Photography is a documentary-style wedding and event photographer focused on candid moments and natural light. His work suits couples and clients who want their day captured authentically rather than heavily posed, and he is comfortable with intimate ceremonies up to large weddings. He is best for clients who value storytelling, real emotion, and a photographer who blends in rather than directs.

name: Frame and Field Studio
description: Frame and Field Studio offers event photography paired with on-site photo booth setups and instant prints. The team is a fun fit for birthdays, corporate parties, debuts, and casual weddings where guests want to take home a tangible keepsake. They are best for clients who want both proper documentation and a built-in entertainment element that keeps guests engaged.

name: Mira Santos Films
description: Mira Santos Films is a cinematic photo and video team known for wedding films with a soft, romantic editorial feel. They offer drone coverage, same-day edits, and full highlight reels suited for couples who want their wedding presented as a story on film. They are best for clients who care equally about both photo and video, and who want a polished, share-ready output.

name: Nine Lens Collective
description: Nine Lens Collective is a team-based photography group built for larger events that need multiple shooters and quick turnaround. They cover corporate conferences, brand launches, large weddings, and press events, and they regularly deliver press-ready images within tight deadlines. They are best for clients running bigger productions where one photographer would not be enough.

name: Bloom and Branch Studio
description: Bloom and Branch Studio is a floral-forward styling team known for lush, garden-inspired arrangements and soft romantic palettes. They handle ceremony arches, reception centerpieces, and full event styling for weddings, debuts, and intimate celebrations. They are best for clients who want florals to be a defining design element and prefer organic, natural styling over rigid or themed setups.

name: Konsept Co.
description: Konsept Co. is a high-end event design studio specializing in custom set construction, themed installations, and branded environments. Their work fits luxury weddings, corporate brand events, and large milestone celebrations that call for a fully designed environment rather than off-the-shelf decor. They are best for clients with a strong concept and the budget to bring it to life as a built-out experience.

name: Pastel Party Co.
description: Pastel Party Co. is a playful styling team specializing in kids' birthdays, baby showers, christenings, and themed celebrations. Their work leans bright, soft, and whimsical, with strong balloon work and dessert table setups. They are best for clients planning family-oriented celebrations who want a clearly themed look without committing to a full luxury production.

name: Noir Events Styling
description: Noir Events Styling leans modern, minimalist, and sculptural, working primarily in monochrome and neutral palettes. They are a strong fit for couples and clients who want a clean editorial look without florals overwhelming the space. They are best for clients who appreciate restraint, architectural design, and a contemporary aesthetic that photographs well under any lighting.

name: DJ Mika Reyes
description: DJ Mika Reyes is a versatile open-format DJ comfortable across weddings, debuts, corporate parties, and milestone birthdays. She works closely with clients to build playlists that fit the crowd and program flow, and is known for keeping the dance floor active without leaning on a single genre. She is best for clients who want a DJ who reads the room well and balances guest requests with curated sets.

name: The Velvet Trio
description: The Velvet Trio is an acoustic live group performing soft jazz, bossa nova, and stripped-down covers of pop and OPM. Their sets fit ceremonies, cocktail hours, intimate dinners, and anniversaries where the goal is warm ambient music rather than a dance party. They are best for clients who want live music as an atmosphere builder and prefer an elegant, mellow vibe.

name: Riot Squad Live Band
services: OPM, pop, rock, and dance covers
description: Riot Squad Live Band is a high-energy cover band that performs OPM, pop, rock, and dance hits for weddings, corporate parties, and milestone celebrations. Their setup is built for larger events with a real dance floor, and they coordinate easily with lights and sound providers. They are best for clients who want live energy as the centerpiece of the night and a band that can keep a big crowd moving.

name: Magic and Mischief Co.
description: Magic and Mischief Co. is a kids-focused entertainment team offering magic shows, hosts, face painting, balloon twisting, and themed party games. They are a strong fit for kids' birthdays, christenings, family days, and school events where the priority is keeping children engaged and entertained throughout the program. They are best for clients planning family-oriented celebrations who want professional party hosts rather than DIY entertainment.
